name: Single malt whisky
about: Scotland's most famous spirit, made from malted barley and aged in oak casks. Edinburgh is a natural place to buy it, since the city sits near many Scottish distilleries.
tip: Pick a region and strength you enjoy. Independent bottlings are also available here and offer unusual flavours.

name: Shortbread
where: Delis that stock Shortbread House of Edinburgh
about: A buttery Scottish biscuit, made in Edinburgh. It is a classic gift that travels well.
tip: Check the butter content and the best-before date before you buy.

name: Harris Tweed wallet
where: Harris Tweed specialist shops, Royal Mile
about: A small leather-and-tweed wallet made from Scottish wool. Harris Tweed is a fabric protected by law and tied to the Scottish islands.
tip: Look for the Orb certification label to confirm the fabric is genuine.
